purpose: Reject a generalization without necessarily denying every case.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain clause + というわけではない
A high price does not necessarily mean it will last.
It is not that I dislike it, but I do not eat it every day.
It is not the case that everyone agreed.
formation: Plain clause + というわけではない
restrictions: Often narrows an inference, cause, or degree.
mistake: It usually means not necessarily, rather than a complete opposite.
